annotations.title: Say therfore.
annotations.text: Abraham concealed that Sarai was his wife, and lyed not in saying, she was his sister: as he also called Lot his brother, <mn>[1]</mn>being his brothers sonne, and she his brothers daughter. VVherby he preuented danger of his owne life, vsing such lawful meanes as lay in him, committing his wiues chastitie to Gods protection, which him self could not prouide for. <mn>[2]</mn> In which case if he had not donne his owne endeuour, he had rather tempted God (saith S Augustin) <mn>[3]</mn> then trusted in God. And so God preserued her, though she was in Pharao his house. v. 17.

notes.text: Men are bond to do their lawful endeuoures, and to commit the rest to God.
